name: pang-daily-trailer
description: Pang Daily vertical trailer (TikTok / Reels / Shorts), edited in Remotion

scripts.render:story: remotion render StoryWide ../renders/pang_daily_ghost_line_16x9.mp4 --codec=h264 --audio-codec=aac --crf=16 && remotion render StoryTall ../renders/pang_daily_ghost_line_9x16.mp4 --codec=h264 --audio-codec=aac --crf=16
scripts.brand: for c in Icon IconDark IconMark CoverTrailer CoverBattle YouTubeBanner; do remotion still $c ../renders/tiktok/brand/$c.png || exit 1; done
